about: Every screen name scripts/store-screenshots.sh timeline captures for Tenshu Timeline (`captured`, from the UI test in `uiTests`). The fixture is generated for the run's day (store/fixtures/timeline/generate_timeline.py: two weeks at home in Milan, then three days in Florence ending today) and goes in through the shared Google Timeline importer on a -seedFixture launch; the trip is made by tapping Read as a trip (docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §3f). Adding a capture means adding it here. Docs: docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §5.

01-today.shows: Home: today's chapter, the places visited and the walks between them

02-suggestion.shows: The trip suggestion under today: three days in Florence, Read as a trip or Not a trip

03-trip.shows: The trip after accepting it: its route over the map, days, places and stops

04-walk.shows: A walk across the river: its route on the map, distance, duration and mode

05-places.shows: Places: every place, with its visit count

06-place.shows: One place: its pin on the map and its visits

android.about: The Android pipeline (scripts/store-screenshots-android.sh timeline, walk in scripts/lib/android_shots.py) captures these on a 1080x2400 phone AVD, light only, keyed android/phone/<lang>/NN-screen.
